title: Coret Aja
mood: giddy, rowdy and proud, a lump in the throat underneath
subject: the last day of SMA, when the whole class scribbles signatures and jokes on each other's white uniforms with markers and the homeroom teacher pretends to disapprove, then signs a sleeve himself
caption: Indonesian idol pop in the 48-group style. A fast-strummed clean electric guitar driving eighth notes, a bright saw-synth lead doubled by brass stabs on the hook, an octave-bouncing picked bass, driving four-on-the-floor drums with big snare-roll fills into each chorus, string-section swells, and a half-step key change into the final chorus. Bright, wide and loud, the unison vocals forward, with gaps left after the chant lines. Young female group: solo lines passed between members in the verses, bright head-voice unison on the chorus, and a shouted crowd chant answering in the bridge. 156 BPM, A major. Giddy, rowdy and proud, a whole class marking the last day of school. No trap drums, no rap verse, no autotune, no EDM drop, no K-pop dance break, no mellow city-pop groove, no ballad tempo.
lyrics:
[Intro - strummed guitar and synth brass hit, crowd count-in]

[Verse 1 - Solo]
Bel terakhir bunyi di kelas dua belas tiga
Tutup spidol berserakan di bawah meja
Kemeja putih tiga tahun, kerahnya udah kuning
Hari ini biarin kotor, hari ini harus penuh

[Pre-Chorus - Solo]
Dito nulis "utang gorengan goceng" di punggungku
Aku gambar kumis di atas saku bajunya

[Chorus - Group]
Coret aja! Punggung, lengan, kerah juga
Coret aja! Nama, nomor HP, sama ejekan
Spidol permanen, dicuci nggak bakal hilang
Biar Mama ngomel di rumah, ini bukti kita lulus

[Verse 2 - Solo]
Pak Hendra masuk, kacamatanya turun ke hidung
"Siapa yang ngajarin kalian kayak gini?"
Semua diam, spidol disembunyiin di belakang
Dia julurkan tangan, "Mana? Yang hitam, dong"

[Bridge - crowd chant answers each line]
Pak Hendra! (Tanda tangan!)
Lengan kiri! (Kiri!)
Yang gede, Pak! (Gede!)
Jangan cuma paraf! (Lengkap!)

[Chorus - Group, key change]
Coret aja! Punggung, lengan, kerah juga
Coret aja! Tanda tangan Pak Hendra paling gede
Spidol permanen, dicuci nggak bakal hilang
Biar Mama ngomel di rumah, wali kelas juga ikutan

[Outro - brass stabs and a final snare roll]
Ma, kemeja ini jangan dicuci, ya!
